subject: Actionable recap + POC onboard sprint plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <l.park@stratosense.ai>, Marcus Nguyen <m.nguyen@stratosense.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Actionable recap + POC onboard sprint plan

Hi Lydia / Marcus —

Thanks again for the product demo earlier — below is a concise, actionable recap so we can move to a short POC quickly. I pulled this out of today's call and aligned owners and next steps.

TL;DR (what we agreed)
- Pain: StratoSense needs consistent, low-latency inference for conversational summarization across mixed-length inputs (avg 400 tokens, 99th pct 1,600 tokens).
- Goal: Reduce end-to-end latency for extractive/summary generation to < 450ms p95 while keeping inference cost within target (benchmark: $0.002 / 1k tokens).
- POC scope (3 weeks): ingest a representative dataset (5k sample docs), run prompt/eval suite (30 prompt families), measure latency/cost/quality delta vs current infra.

POC owners (who does what)
- StratoSense: Lydia (POC sponsor) — provide sample dataset and map of data sensitivities; Marcus — engineering lead for access & network allowlist.
- Redwood: Irene (engagement lead) — overall coordination; Karthik — model/quantization recommendations & eval setup; Ben — infra & test-key provisioning; Kimberly — contracting / procurement support.

Success metrics (we'll instrument these during the POC)
- p95 latency for the summary endpoint <= 450ms (target)
- Generation accuracy: maintain current ROUGE-L baseline or improve by >= 4 points on priority prompts
- Cost per 1k tokens at or below target (we'll provide two profiles: conservative and aggressive quantization)

Immediate asks / access checklist (items StratoSense to provide)
1) A sanitized 5k-document sample (S3 link or shared Drive) — format: newline-delimited JSON, fields: id, text, metadata.
2) Engineering allowlist (IP range OR CIDR / SSH certs) for our temporary test keys.
3) Contact for security questionnaire (SOC-2 evidence if required).

Redwood deliverables this week\- 48h: POC scope PDF + onboarding checklist (attached: stratosense-poc-scope.pdf)\- 72h: temporary test API key + test harness and initial prompt set (we'll send via secure link)\- End of week: baseline eval run and short readout (metrics + recommended settings)

Proposed timeline (condensed sprint)
- Week 0 (this week): access & data handed off; kickoff call scheduled
- Week 1: baseline runs, prompt tuning, instrumentation
- Week 2: quality eval & latency/cost profiling; iterate on batching/quantization profiles
- Week 3: readout & handoff (recommendations and next-step commitment)

Next steps (please confirm)
- Lydia: share sample dataset + allowlist by EOD Thursday
- Marcus: confirm a 30-min kickoff on Monday (Nov 29) or Tuesday (Nov 30) — suggest times in PT
- Redwood: we'll post the onboarding checklist to the shared Drive and send the initial test key after allowlist is confirmed.

Attachments: stratosense-poc-scope.pdf (POC scope + success metric template)

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

— Irene Choi

- For the allowlist: we prefer an SSH-based cert allowlist; Marcus will share our engineer's IP ranges if you need a CIDR.
- Security: our InfoSec team will want the SOC-2 questionnaire and any data-retention/egress language up front; can Kimberly start that thread?

One ask: can Redwood confirm whether temporary test keys will be scoped to the POC dataset only (not production models)? We need that for internal approvals.

Kickoff: Monday Nov 29 at 10:00 PT works for Marcus and me — we'll book the 30-min call if that still works for Redwood.

Quick reply requested on the test key scoping and whether we should add a dedicated Slack channel for day-to-day troubleshooting.

Hi Lydia — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirmations below: 

- Test keys: yes — temporary test keys will be scoped to the POC environment and dataset. Keys will be time-limited (30 days) and bound to the allowlist you provide. We will not expose production models unless you request a production-model comparison explicitly.
- Slack channel: agreed — please add redwood-poc-stratosense@slack (or send preferred channel) and we'll add Karthik and Ben as primary contacts for troubleshooting.
- Kimberly: I added you on the cc for the SOC/Q prework. Kimberly, can you kick off the questionnaire thread with Lydia's InfoSec team and drop the link to our compliance packet?

I've uploaded the onboarding checklist and the short POC scope doc to the shared Drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bPocScope (view/comment). Also attached the setup checklist (redwood-poc-setup-checklist.xlsx) for Marcus' engineering team — it has the allowlist and SSH cert instructions.

Proposed kickoff: Monday Nov 29, 10:00 PT — I'll schedule and send a calendar invite to this thread.

Ben / Karthik: action items below for internal tracking: 
- Ben: provision temporary test API key after allowlist is confirmed; add allowlist IPs to ssh-allowlist.txt and send to Marcus.
- Karthik: prepare initial prompt families and evaluation harness (30 prompt families) by Friday; I'll coordinate inputs from StratoSense.

Thanks — we'll be ready to kick on Monday.
